result.summary: Outside-problem credit has not been fixed for V2.1, and the problem the spec names still exists. Tapping "Needed help" on Today writes result 'hinted'. dailyCredits gives that a full qualifying credit ('outside-hinted'), so the Today counter, the "Day complete … You did enough" hero, the week total, the streak and the flame all count it. Meanwhile the LeetCode card on the same page says "Not finished yet … that is the solve that counts", and the unit test (credit.test.ts:46-54) asserts that the bug is the intended behaviour. The data model has only three values (unaided | hinted | failed) plus a dateless boolean 'rebuilt'. Nothing separates seeing the solution from a small hint. The rebuild toggle is only offered on the day of the solve, and only for new problems that have a bridge target; credit.ts, the solve log and readiness never read it. A later cold re-solve (review1-3 or redo, unaided) is credited exactly like a first solve, and readiness ignores outside evidence entirely. Other credit holes: (a) the same LC problem logged N times on one day earns N credits, because credit is keyed by entry id and the /log form mints a new out:<uuid> id each time; the date field also accepts past and future dates. (b) "Run it back" right after a revealed solution earns full same-day credit. It then counts as a 'clean' pass, so the next day's cold pass is upgraded to 'retrieval' (cold evidence). (c) Explain reps count on a self-ticked rubric and land in readiness as cold-independent full-problem evidence. (d) The rep pass panel shows "+1 rep" on every pass, including choice, lab, revealed, same-day-repeat and generated reps, all of which earn 0. (e) 13 choice reps sit in required unit paths and never count; 7 of them (Week 14) are shown on Today as required "Checkpoint" items. What works: same-day repeat dedup, the 'revealed' → no-credit rule, lab and choice exclusion, the gate clean standard, the redo scheduling, and a single credit source in course mode.
result.data:
RESULT VALUES (lib/solve-log.ts:12): SolveResult = 'unaided' | 'hinted' | 'failed'; SolveEntry.rebuilt?: boolean (no date; :28-29); SolveEntry.kind = 'new' | 'review1' | 'review2' | 'review3' | 'redo' | 'outside' (ids lc:<n>:<kind>, redo:<n>:<due>, out:<uuid>).

WHAT THE UI WRITES
- Today LeetcodeList (components/leetcode-list.tsx):
  - "Unaided" → result 'unaided' (:136).
  - "Needed help" → result 'hinted' (:139). The button also shows as pressed for 'failed', and tapping it over a 'failed' entry rewrites the entry to 'hinted', which makes it creditable.
  - Tapping the active button again deletes the entry (:52).
  - "I rebuilt it from blank" toggles rebuilt (:155). It appears only when the item is type 'new', has a bridge target state, and the result is hinted or failed (:83, :148).
  - The Walkthrough link records nothing (:131-134).
  - There is no Failed and no "saw solution" button.
- /log form (components/solve-log-view.tsx): Unaided / Hinted / Failed (:196-200). The date accepts any value (:188). Every manual log gets a new out:<uuid> id (:109). Edit can change the date and result of any entry (:110-120). There is no rebuilt field, and the history table never shows rebuilt.

dailyCredits OUTCOMES (run through the real functions)
- new unaided → 1 'outside-unaided'
- new hinted → 1 'outside-hinted'
- hinted + rebuilt:true → 1 'outside-hinted' (rebuilt ignored)
- failed → 0
- review1 or review3 unaided (later cold re-solve) → 1 'outside-unaided', identical to a first solve
- redo hinted → 1. Logged "Needed help" every day, LC 1 earned 1 credit on each of 6 consecutive training days (10-30, 11-02, 11-03, 11-04, 11-05, 11-06).
- Entry with no LC number (OA or mock) → 0
- LC 1 logged 4 times on one day (lc:1:new plus 3 out:<uuid>) → 4 credits
- Entry dated a past or future day → credited on that day

REP SCENARIOS
- Reveal at 10:00, then "Run it back" at 10:04 the same day → credited, evidence 'reconstructed'.
  - Next-day cold pass after that → evidence 'retrieval', coldEvidence true, gateClean true.
  - The same next-day cold pass without the run-it-back → 'reconstructed', false, false.
- Revealed attempt not passed, then passed 20 minutes later → credited 'reconstructed'.
- Same rep passed 3 times on one day → 1 credit.
- 4 hints (up to the outline level) → qualifies, 'assisted' (same as 1 hint).
- Choice → does not qualify. Explain (self-checked) → qualifies. Lab part → does not qualify. gen-* rep → 0 (not in the static EXERCISE_BY_ID passed by use-credits.ts:17).
- Gate pass after 3 failed runs → qualifies, but is not gateClean.

CONTENT
- Exercise kinds: code 1011, output 100, explain 32, choice 13, reorder 3.
- Explain reps: all 32 are in required unit paths (W2 4, W3 3, W4 2, W5 3, W7 3, W8 4, W9 3, W10 1, W11 3, W14 6). The default stage is 'interview', which makes them full-problem evidence in readiness.
- Choice reps in required unit paths: 13. W2 has 5 (o2-list-literal, o2-set-empty, o2-drev-crash, o2-dl-empty, o2-dl-crash), W8 has 1 (o7-dq-why-not-pop0), W14 has 7 (o11-speed-slicing, o11-cx-heap-k, -subsets, -memo, -tree-space, -grid-bfs, -pop-front). The 7 W14 reps have stage 'retrieval' and repType 'cold', so routing gives them purpose 'gate': Today shows them as required "Checkpoint" items, and they earn 0 credit.
- 92 output/trace reps in required paths are credited by credit.ts but count as "passive" under training-state.isProductive.
- Gate pools contain 119 code variants and 1 output variant, so every gate pass qualifies.
- Every lab build and change-request exercise has lab:true. No lab parts are in required paths.
- 48 course LC targets. 3 of them (LC 217, 1971, 547) have no bridge target, so they never get the "Not finished yet" or rebuild panel. Re-solves and redos never get it either.
- No exercise id collides with a solve-log id.

WHERE LC SOLVES COUNT TOWARD THE DAY
- Course mode: useCredits → dailyCredits feeds the Today counter and hero (use-course-day.ts:25,35), the plan done-state (use-today-plan.ts:94-95 keeps only keys that earned credit, so a hinted LC shows ✓ and struck through), capacity (use-capacity.ts:61), week, streak, flame and momentum (week-status.ts), and Road to Ready (road-map.tsx:41-44).
- Before course start, live until 2026-10-26: doneToday includes every LC entry logged today, failed ones too (use-today-plan.ts:91, counted=null), and useDayRecords counts every entry with an LC number as a rep whatever its result (use-capacity.ts:41-46).
alreadyCorrect: After COURSE_START there is one credit source: dailyCredits (via useCredits) drives the Today counter and Day complete (use-course-day.ts:25,35; course-today.tsx:67-68), the Today plan done-state (use-today-plan.ts:94-95 keeps only keys that earned credit), capacity (use-capacity.ts:61), week progress, streak, flame and momentum (week-status.ts), and Road to Ready totals (road-map.tsx:41-44). No second counter competes in course mode.
A rep passed several times on the same day counts once: credit.ts:96-101 counts only the first qualifying pass per day (tested in credit.test.ts:39-44).
A solution shown in the same attempt earns no credit and is classified 'revealed' (credit.ts:51, :66). Routing's passedIds also leaves revealed passes out of unit paths (routing.ts:69-71).
A later pass after a reveal, with no run-it-back in between, is classified 'reconstructed': it is not cold evidence and not gate-clean (credit.ts:53-55; credit.test.ts:28-32).
Labs never count (credit.ts:64). Every lab build and change-request exercise carries lab:true (0 missing), and no lab part sits in a required unit path.
Multiple-choice recognition never earns credit (credit.ts:37, :65).
Failed reps and failed LC entries never count in course mode (credit.ts:46, :105).

The gate clean standard (credit.ts:77-80) rejects hints, revealed solutions, reconstructions and more than 2 failed runs. The checkpoint UI hides hints, the solution and the concept guide (rep-workspace.tsx:821-826, :1440, :1489). Every gate-pool variant is a production kind (119 code, 1 output), so a gate pass always earns daily credit.

Help on reps is recorded: static hints, AI hints, the Basics panel on cold reps and the ConceptGuide onAssisted callback all increment hintsUsed (rep-workspace.tsx:567-608, :978). Watching the walkthrough of an in-app capstone sets solutionViewed (:610-615). Masterful evidence classification already separates assisted, reconstructed, self-corrected, retrieval and cold-independent for reps.

Redo scheduling works and is tested: a re-solve that needed help comes back on the next training day (resolves.ts:36-43; resolves.test.ts:20-23). Spaced +3/+10/+30 re-solves are also correct (resolves.ts:44-53).

The solve-log schema already separates first solve, re-solve and redo through kind (solve-log.ts:13, :16, :22) and already has a rebuilt field. Entries are stored in study_state under solve:<id>, so the evidence states V2.1 needs can be added without a storage migration.
Rep credit and outside credit share one seen set in dailyCredits, and no exercise id collides with a solve-log id (lc:/redo:/out:).

findings.title: 'Needed help' LeetCode solves still earn full daily credit while the same page says 'Not finished yet'
findings.specSection: §10 Daily credit rule ('The UI and the credit logic must agree'); §2 principles 6 and 12; §7
findings.evidence: lib/course/credit.ts:105-107 `if (e.date !== date || !e.lc || e.result === 'failed' || seen.has(e.id)) continue` … `evidence: e.result === 'unaided' ? 'outside-unaided' : 'outside-hinted'`; credit.ts:12 "an outside problem solved and logged (unaided or with hints) counts once"; components/leetcode-list.tsx:139-140 `onClick={() => set(i, 'hinted')}` … `Needed help`; leetcode-list.tsx:150-152 "Not finished yet: rebuild it, then go back down the ladder." … "It comes back cold in 3 days: that is the solve that counts."; components/use-today-plan.ts:91 `...entries.filter((e) => e.date === today && e.lc)` and :94-95 keeps entries in `counted`; lib/today-plan.ts:110,156 → `done: true`; components/course/course-today.tsx:68 `const complete = day.type === 'training' && done >= target`, :170 "You did enough."; lib/course/credit.test.ts:49,53 asserts `[217, 'outside-hinted']` is credited
findings.detail: Every path that excludes only 'failed' credits a 'hinted' entry, and 'hinted' is the only thing the Today 'Needed help' button can write. Example: a Week 3 Monday with a target of 15. The learner passes 14 reps, attempts LC 128 for 30 minutes ('attempt for up to 30 min, then study', leetcode-list.tsx:35), watches the walkthrough and taps 'Needed help'. dailyCredits returns 15 items. The hero switches to 'Day complete 15 / 15 · You did enough.', LC 128 is ticked and struck through in the training list, and the streak, week total, flame and milestones all go up. The LeetCode card directly below says 'Not finished yet … that is the solve that counts'. Three days later the review1 earns another full credit. The unit test makes 'hinted counts' a requirement, so fixing the behaviour will break the suite. use-course-day.ts:36 does not even count 'outside-hinted' as assisted.
findings.suggestedFix: Put outside credit in credit.ts as an `outsideCredit(entry, entries)` that returns { credited: boolean, evidence, label }. Credit 'unaided' on the solve day. Credit a small hint as 'outside-assisted' only if the spec's severity rule allows it. Never credit solution exposure until a later rebuild or cold solve. Drive the LeetcodeList copy and the ✓ state from the same function, so 'Not finished yet' and 'not credited' are always produced together. Replace credit.test.ts:46-54 with the §29 outside-solve cases.

findings.title: The outside evidence model cannot tell a small hint from solution exposure; Today offers only Unaided / Needed help
findings.specSection: §10 Outside problem evidence model (UNAIDED, HINTED, SOLUTION_VIEWED, REBUILT, COLD_RESOLVE, FAILED)
findings.evidence: lib/solve-log.ts:12 `export type SolveResult = 'unaided' | 'hinted' | 'failed'`; components/leetcode-list.tsx:136-141 (two buttons only), :139 `aria-pressed={r === 'hinted' || r === 'failed'}`; leetcode-list.tsx:131-134 the Walkthrough `<a href={i.video} …>` records nothing (compare rep-workspace.tsx:610-615, where the walkthrough sets `solutionViewed: true` for in-app capstones); components/solve-log-view.tsx:196-200 options Unaided/Hinted/Failed; lib/course/credit.ts:88 `evidence: Evidence | 'outside-unaided' | 'outside-hinted'`; leetcode-list.tsx:50-54 tapping 'Needed help' on a 'failed' entry saves `result: 'hinted'`
findings.detail: A small nudge, watching the full walkthrough and copying the editorial are all stored as 'hinted'. Today has no 'Failed' or 'saw the solution' button; 'failed' can only be set from /log. So any problem logged from Today is credited, and tapping 'Needed help' on a 'failed' entry upgrades it to a credited 'hinted'. The product's own flow for new problems ('attempt for up to 30 min, then study') leads straight to solution exposure, and the only honest button on Today then credits it.
findings.suggestedFix: Extend SolveResult to unaided | hinted (optionally with a hintLevel) | solution | failed. Add a 'Saw the solution' or 'Couldn't solve' button on Today. Mark the entry as solution-exposed when the Walkthrough link is opened before logging. Migrate existing 'hinted' entries conservatively, for example to hinted with an unknown severity.

findings.title: 'Rebuilt from blank' is a dateless boolean, recordable only on the solve day, and never credited, shown or used as evidence
findings.specSection: §10 (Solution viewed + later rebuild from blank → reconstruction credit); §11 reconstructed category; §29 'reconstruction'
findings.evidence: lib/solve-log.ts:28-29 `rebuilt?: boolean` (no date); components/leetcode-list.tsx:83 `const state = i.type === 'new' ? byLc.get(i.lc) : undefined`, :148 `{state && helped && entry && (`, :155 `save({ ...entry, rebuilt: !entry.rebuilt })`; lib/course/resolves.ts:56-57 a new item is listed only `if (!done || done.date === today)`; components/solve-log-view.tsx:39 and :172-214 have no rebuilt field and :58-71 never show it; `rebuilt` is referenced only in leetcode-list.tsx and solve-log.ts (credit.ts never reads it); components/course/readiness-report.tsx:69 'Rebuilt after a solution' = r.evidence.reconstructed (reps only); e2e/reps.spec.ts:231-232 only checks aria-pressed
findings.detail: The panel and toggle exist only on the day of the first solve, because the next day the 'new' item leaves the list. They exist only for new problems with a bridge target: none of the 48 course targets get them on re-solves or redos, and LC 217, 1971 and 547 never get them. A rebuild done on a later day therefore cannot be recorded anywhere, since /log has no field for it. Toggling the flag changes no credit, no evidence and no readiness count. The heading still says 'Not finished yet' after 'Rebuilt from blank' is pressed (:150 is unconditional). The entry's `at` timestamp changes on any edit, so it cannot stand in for a rebuild date.
findings.suggestedFix: Record a rebuild as its own dated event, for example a `rebuild:<lc>:<date>` entry or `rebuiltOn: date`, that dailyCredits credits as 'reconstructed' on that date. Require it to be a different session or day from the solution exposure. Offer it from Today's re-solve list and from the /log form. Show it in the solve-log history and feed it into the readiness 'reconstructed' count.

findings.title: A later cold re-solve is credited exactly like a first solve, and outside evidence never reaches readiness
findings.specSection: §10 (Later cold re-solve → strongest evidence); §11 (later stronger evidence must upgrade the report)
findings.evidence: lib/course/credit.ts:107 evidence depends only on `e.result` (`e.kind` is ignored); script: review1 and review3 'unaided' → 'outside-unaided', the same as a 'new' unaided solve; lib/course/readiness.ts:71 `export function evidenceSummary(attempts: Attempt[], exercises: Record<string, Exercise>, today: string)` takes no solve entries; components/use-course-day.ts:39 `evidenceSummary(attempts, EXERCISE_BY_ID, today)`; lib/solve-log.ts:94-99 unaidedRate is the only consumer that tells re-solves apart
findings.detail: The data to identify a cold re-solve already exists (kind = review1, review2, review3 or redo), but the credit and evidence model collapses everything into 'outside-unaided' or 'outside-hinted'. A problem first logged with help and later re-solved cold three times never upgrades anywhere: the readiness report's evidence counts (Cold independent, Self-corrected, Assisted, 'Rebuilt after a solution') ignore every LeetCode outcome.
findings.suggestedFix: Map unaided review1-3 and redo entries to a distinct 'outside-cold' evidence, ranked strongest. Pass solve entries into evidenceSummary or readiness, and let a problem's best later evidence replace its first-attempt classification.

findings.title: The rep pass panel always shows '+1 rep', even for passes that earn no credit
findings.specSection: §10 ('The UI and the credit logic must agree'); §2 principle 12; §19
findings.evidence: components/rep/rep-workspace.tsx:1392-1394 unconditional `Rep complete{runItBack ? ' · reconstructed' : ''}` … `+1 rep`; rep-workspace.tsx:973 on lab parts: "Labs are done or not done; their builds are not counted as reps."; lib/course/credit.ts:64-66 (lab, non-production kinds and solutionViewed do not qualify) and :100 (same-day repeat); components/use-credits.ts:17 passes the static `EXERCISE_BY_ID`, while generated reps are resolved from `repo.generated()` (lib/sessions.ts:28-29), so script: 'gen-123' → 0 credits
findings.detail: The badge appears on choice passes, lab build and change-request passes, passes after 'Show solution', second and later passes of the same rep that day, and every 'Another / Easier / Harder rep' (gen-*) pass. All of them earn 0 in dailyCredits, so the Today counter does not move. On a lab part the page says the build is not counted, then shows '+1 rep' on the same screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Compute the badge from credit.ts: `qualifies(attempt, exercise)` and not already credited for that exercise today. When the pass does not count, show the reason instead ('Not counted: solution shown', 'recognition', 'lab part', 'already counted today', 'generated practice'). Separately, decide whether generated drills should qualify and, if so, pass findExercise-resolved exercises into dailyCredits.

findings.title: 'Run it back' immediately after a revealed solution earns full credit the same day, then upgrades the next cold pass to 'retrieval'
findings.specSection: §10 (solution viewed does not qualify yet; reconstruction only on a later rebuild); REPS_2_MASTER_SPEC §13 ('copying a solution' does not count; 'later successful reconstruction' does), §55 (test immediate reconstruction)
findings.evidence: components/rep/rep-workspace.tsx:628-636 doRunItBack: `attemptRef.current = null` … `setSolutionShown(false)` creates a new attempt with solutionViewed:false; lib/progress.ts:193 `if (opts.runItBack) return 'immediate-reconstruction'`; rep-workspace.tsx:1424 highlights 'Run it back' with btn-accent after help and :1438 prompts to use it; lib/course/credit.ts:63-67 `qualifies` ignores retrievalType; :47 `const clean = (a) => passedAttempt(a) && a.hintsUsed === 0 && !a.solutionViewed` counts the run-it-back as clean; :55 and :57; lib/course/credit.test.ts:26 claims "Immediate reconstruction in the same attempt is the revealed attempt itself: no credit"
findings.detail: Script results: a reveal at 10:00 followed by Run it back at 10:04 is credited the same day as 'reconstructed'. Because that immediate copy is 'clean', a cold pass the next day is classified 'retrieval' with coldEvidence and gateClean both true. Without the run-it-back, the same pass is 'reconstructed' with both false. On capstones, which count as full problems in readiness.ts:72, this inflates the readiness bucket 'Cold, independent' (readiness.ts:84). The UI actively pushes this path, and no test covers it.
findings.suggestedFix: In qualifies(), deny credit to 'immediate-reconstruction' passes, or to any pass made the same day as or within N hours of a reveal on that exercise. In masteryEvidence, exclude immediate-reconstruction passes from `clean`, so the first later pass after a reveal stays 'reconstructed'. Add the §55 immediate-reconstruction and later-cold-reconstruction tests using a separate run-it-back attempt.

findings.title: Explain reps count as full qualifying production on a self-ticked rubric and are classified as cold-independent full-problem evidence
findings.specSection: §2 principles 6 and 11; §11 (no stronger language than evidence supports); REPS_2_MASTER_SPEC §13 (explanation counts only 'when explicitly authored as active production')
findings.evidence: lib/course/credit.ts:37 `const PRODUCTION: Exercise['kind'][] = ['code', 'output', 'reorder', 'explain']`; components/rep/rep-workspace.tsx:538-541 `if (explainText.trim().length < 40) …` `const need = Math.ceil((ex.rubric?.length ?? 1) * 0.6)` `finish(covered >= need, …)`; the AI checkExplanation at :788-799 is optional and never gates the pass; data/exercises/build.ts:137-138 explain defaults to `stage: 'interview', repType: 'interview'`; lib/course/readiness.ts:72 `full` includes `e.stage === 'interview'`, and :84 folds 'independent' into coldIndependent
findings.detail: Any 40 characters plus ticking 3 of 5 checkboxes passes. The pass earns a daily credit, gets masteryEvidence 'independent' (or 'cold-independent'), and counts as full-problem 'Cold, independent' evidence in the readiness report. There is no per-rep 'authored as active production' flag. All 32 explain reps are in required unit paths: W2 4, W3 3, W4 2, W5 3, W7 3, W8 4, W9 3, W10 1, W11 3, W14 6.
findings.suggestedFix: Credit an explain rep only when the rubric is verified, for example by requiring the AI check's `met` to clear the threshold, or by allowing it only on reps authored with an explicit `production: true`. Classify self-checked explanations as their own evidence type, separate from independence, and leave them out of the full-problem readiness counts.

findings.title: Outside credits are keyed by entry id, not by problem, and dates are unbounded: duplicate and back- or future-dated credit
findings.specSection: §10; §2 principles 11 and 12; REPS_2_MASTER_SPEC §13 ('repeating the same completed rep multiple times on the same day' does not count)
findings.evidence: lib/course/credit.ts:105-106 `seen.has(e.id)` / `seen.add(e.id)`; components/solve-log-view.tsx:109 `id: \`out:${crypto.randomUUID()}\`` for every manual log; :188 `<input className="input" type="date" required {...field('date')} />` with no min or max; :110-120 Edit rewrites `date` and `result` of any entry; lib/course/resolves.ts:34 `add` dedupes by solveId only
findings.detail: Script results: LC 1 logged once from Today (lc:1:new) and three times from /log (out:<uuid>) on the same day earns 4 credits, enough to complete half of a Week 1 day with one problem. Logging a plan problem again on /log (instead of 'Add notes') double-counts it by accident. An entry dated a past day adds credit to that day, which can turn it 'complete' and repair the streak after the fact. A future-dated entry fills that day's credits in advance. Editing hinted to unaided, or failed to hinted, rewrites history. A redo:<lc>:<due> and a lc:<lc>:reviewK can also both be due and credited for the same LC on the same day.
findings.suggestedFix: Deduplicate outside credit by (date, lc) and keep the strongest evidence. Clamp the /log date to [COURSE_START, today]. Store entry creation separately from the solve date, and decide whether back-dated entries can change streaks. When a plan or target LC is logged manually, write it under its plan id instead of out:<uuid>.

findings.title: Choice reps sit in required unit paths but never earn credit; 7 Week 14 choice reps show on Today as required 'Checkpoint' items
findings.specSection: §7 daily completion contract; §8 (the required path must fit the qualifying contract)
findings.evidence: lib/course/credit.ts:37/:65 (choice is not production); lib/course/routing.ts:148 `const pathDone = full.every((e) => passed.has(e.id))` and :218 queue path reps until passed; routing.ts:194 `if (e.repType === 'cold' || e.stage === 'retrieval') return 'gate'` with data/exercises/oct11.ts:19 `const R = { stage: 'retrieval', repType: 'cold' }` and :1221 `const BIG_O = { stage: 'retrieval', repType: 'cold' }`; components/use-today-plan.ts:65 `required: q.purpose === 'gate' || q.purpose === 'repair'`; components/course/course-today.tsx:42 `gate: 'Checkpoint'`; use-today-plan.ts:94-95 removes items that earned no credit from doneToday
findings.detail: 13 choice reps are in required unit paths: W2 has o2-list-literal, o2-set-empty, o2-drev-crash, o2-dl-empty and o2-dl-crash; W8 has o7-dq-why-not-pop0; W14 has o11-speed-slicing, o11-cx-heap-k, o11-cx-subsets, o11-cx-memo, o11-cx-tree-space, o11-cx-grid-bfs and o11-cx-pop-front. Unit completion requires them, yet passing one does not move the day count. On Today the item disappears instead of being ticked (it leaves the queue once passed, and doneToday drops it), and the slot is refilled, so the learner silently does extra work. The 7 W14 reps are labeled 'Checkpoint' with the WHY copy 'Passing it unlocks what comes next', and are marked required, although they are not gates and never count.
findings.suggestedFix: Move recognition reps out of required paths into optional or lesson material. Alternatively, have the plan show them as non-counting 'learn' items that tick off without credit. In purposeOf, return 'gate' only for real gate-pool exercises (GATE_OF_EXERCISE), not for every repType 'cold' or stage 'retrieval' rep.

findings.title: The §29 outside-solve tests are missing, and the existing test locks in the bug
findings.specSection: §29 Testing requirements (outside solve: unaided credit; hinted behaviour; solution-viewed behaviour; reconstruction; cold re-solve); REPS_2_MASTER_SPEC §55
findings.evidence: lib/course/credit.test.ts:46-54 `assert.deepEqual(credits.map((c) => [c.lc, c.evidence]), [[1, 'outside-unaided'], [217, 'outside-hinted']])`; credit.test.ts:26 immediate reconstruction exists only as a comment; e2e/reps.spec.ts:229-233 clicks 'Needed help' and 'I rebuilt it from blank' and asserts only aria-pressed
findings.detail: No unit or e2e test covers solution-viewed, reconstruction after a rebuild, a cold re-solve as the strongest evidence, same-LC deduplication, or immediate run-it-back credit. The one outside test asserts the behaviour §10 says to remove.
findings.suggestedFix: Write the §29 cases before changing credit.ts: unaided → credit; small hint → assisted per policy; solution → 0; a later dated rebuild → 'reconstructed'; review1-3 unaided → strongest; the same LC twice in a day → 1. Add a rep test where a separate run-it-back attempt follows a reveal.

findings.title: Two competing definitions of production
findings.specSection: §26 (no contradictory systems); REPS_2_MASTER_SPEC §55 ('Do not let different pages independently invent what counts')
findings.evidence: lib/course/credit.ts:37 decides by kind: `['code', 'output', 'reorder', 'explain']`; lib/training-state.ts:27-32 decides by stage: `const PASSIVE: Stage[] = ['recognize', 'trace']` … `isProductive(a) … !PASSIVE.includes(a.stage)`
findings.detail: Of the required-path reps, 92 output/trace reps earn daily credit but count as passive for freshness and practice, while 7 choice/retrieval reps count as productive but earn no credit. A rep can therefore count toward today and not count toward skill freshness, or the other way round.
findings.suggestedFix: Export a single `isProduction(exercise)` from credit.ts and use it in training-state.practiceBySkill.

findings.title: The 'Day complete' message ignores LeetCode help when judging whether the day leaned on assistance
findings.evidence: components/use-course-day.ts:36 `done.filter((c) => c.evidence === 'assisted' || c.evidence === 'reconstructed').length` (no 'outside-hinted'); data/course/motivation.ts:89 `const leaned = (c.assistedCount ?? 0) > done / 2`

result.summary:
The readiness evidence layer does not meet §11, §18 or §26. One function is sound: credit.ts masteryEvidence classifies a single attempt correctly. The problem is everything that aggregates it.

1. **Merged bucket.** evidenceSummary adds independent + retrieval + cold-independent into one tile labelled "Cold, independent", which is the exact thing §11 forbids. 215 of the 272 "full" reps start as first-exposure, so most of that tile is not cold evidence.
2. **First attempt only.** It counts only the first passing attempt per rep, in array order. That order is not chronological: after a reload, attempts load in IndexedDB key order, and the keys are random UUIDs. So later stronger evidence never upgrades the report, and the numbers can change after a reload.
3. **Revealed solutions block later evidence.** A pass made after viewing the solution (the app's built-in "rebuild from memory" flow) takes the rep's single slot, so its later rebuild and cold re-solve are never counted.
4. **Checkpoint evidence missing.** 63 of 120 checkpoint variants never reach the evidence panel because they lack the `gate` flag. All variants of 11 checkpoints are missing, including hashing, windows, stack, search, rewiring, trees, grid, heap, backtracking and matrix.

Labs, change requests and design or review artifacts do not feed readiness at all. There is no Software Building or Applied AI/FDE dimension.

The Independent transfer and Interview execution rows are never wired. useCourseDay calls readiness() without the transfer grade or mock count. In Weeks 13–14 Today shows "Building" and "Not tested yet" directly above an InterviewCard that shows the actual grade.

Mock gating is only the visibility of one link: /interview stays in the main nav and any mock can be started. finalDecision overclaims. For example, a yellow grade with Programming foundations, Problem decomposition, Graphs and DP not ready, and zero mocks, gets "Ready to start interviewing, with targeted gaps". A green grade gets READY after one mock, even one done in October.

Week, Course and Readiness each use different inputs, and there are three different definitions of a complete week. The rule "a missing lab or checkpoint means the week is not on track" cannot fire from any caller. Every week can show On track while Readiness says "Off track: 3 weeks behind".

Mastery and freshness are separated only by a "· stale" tag on fully-ready domains in the Progress report. That tag disappears if the learner merely views a solution. The Today readiness card shows the five earliest domains and hides weaker later ones.
result.data:
HOW evidenceSummary BUCKETS EVIDENCE (lib/course/readiness.ts:71-90)
- Input: attempts only. The solve log is never passed (use-course-day.ts:39).
- Which reps count: full(e) = capstone OR transfer OR gate flag OR stage 'pattern' OR stage 'interview'. That is 272 of 1159 exercises.
  - Only 57 of the 272 start cold. The other 215 are first-exposure on the first attempt (progress.ts:194-199).
  - 63 of the 120 checkpoint variants are excluded, because they have no gate flag (they are 'cold/retrieval' reps).
- Which attempt counts: one per rep, via `seen` (lines 74-79). It is the first attempt in array order with passed && completedAt, classified by masteryEvidence against the full history.
- What is displayed (readiness-report.tsx:64-77):
  - "Cold, independent" = cold-independent + independent + retrieval (line 84). This is a merge.
  - "Self-corrected" = self-corrected.
  - "Assisted" = assisted.
  - "Rebuilt after a solution" = reconstructed.
  - Never displayed: revealed (it still takes the rep's slot) and failed.
  - There are no separate independent or retrieval counts.
- recentAssistance: passes with hints or solutionViewed, divided by all passes of any rep kind, over today-9 to today (10 calendar days). Reconstructions are not counted as help.

ATTEMPT ORDER
- engine.all() returns Map insertion order (sync.ts:56-62).
- On reload the cache is filled from IndexedDB getAll (local.ts:26-28; sync.ts:103), which returns rows in key order.
- Keys are crypto.randomUUID() (sessions.ts:13-14; rep-workspace.tsx:393), so after a reload the order is effectively random in time.
- dailyCredits sorts by time. evidenceSummary and transferGrade do not.

SIMULATIONS (throwaway scripts, already deleted from scripts/)
- A. Same capstone: assisted pass, then a cold clean pass a week later. Chronological order gives assisted 1, cold 0. Reversed order gives cold 1, assisted 0.
- B. One capstone with [revealed, reconstructed, cold pass] (the cold pass classifies as retrieval). Every bucket stays 0.
- C. One clean first-exposure pass on cap-two-sum (classified independent) is shown as "Cold, independent: 1".
- D. A clean cold pass on o2-cold-two-sum (a g-hashing checkpoint variant) leaves every bucket at 0.
- E. A transfer rep with [assisted, later slow cold pass]. Chronological order gives independent 0; reversed gives independent 1 and freshFull 1.
- F. The first 12 bank reps solved clean grades yellow (freshFull 3, because only 12 of the 48 bank reps can count as full). Adding 8 abandoned failing tries raises attempted to 20.
- G. readiness() called the way useCourseDay calls it, on 2027-01-27: transfer is 'building' and interview is 'not-tested'. With the grade and mock count passed in: 'ready' and 'developing'.
- H. Week 3 with full output but labs 0/2 and gates 0/3:
  - today = Sunday gives on-track, with or without the extras;
  - the next Monday with the extras gives recoverable.
  - Every caller uses today ≤ Sunday or passes no extras, so the lab/gate rule never fires.
- I. finalDecision:
  - yellow, foundations + decomposition + graphs + dp not ready, 0 mocks → ready-with-gaps;
  - green, every domain stale, 1 mock → ready;
  - green, 1 mock (the green policy requires 2) → ready;
  - green, track off-track, 1 mock → ready;
  - green, 0 mocks → ready-with-gaps.
- J. Evidence {cold 0, assisted 40, reconstructed 20, recent help 0.39} gives on-track, with the why line "Output, checkpoints and independence are where the plan needs them."
- K. Weeks 1–3 output met only with reps outside every unit (74 such qualifying reps exist): every week is on-track, while the track is off-track with "The course is 3 weeks behind the calendar."
- L. Week 8, with units W1–7 ready except w6-recursion gate-blocked: ReadinessCard shows foundations, decomposition, hashing, pointers and windows, all READY. Recursion (DEVELOPING) is hidden.
- M. Hashing domain ready since Nov 5, today Nov 25, so it is stale. One unpassed attempt that only viewed a solution on a w2-hashing rep turns stale to false.

READINESS DIMENSIONS: CODE vs SPEC §18
- What the code has (readiness.ts:26-42 plus two extra rows):
  - 15 topic domains: Programming foundations, Problem decomposition, Hashing, Pointers and running state, Sliding window, Stacks, Binary search, Linked lists, Recursion, Trees, Graphs, Heaps and intervals, Backtracking, Basic DP and greedy, Matrix and tries.
  - An Independent transfer row (never wired to the grade).
  - An Interview execution row (never wired to mocks; it can never become 'ready').
- Against the spec:

| Spec dimension | In code |
|---|---|
| Programming Foundations | ≈ foundations |
| Problem Solving | ≈ decomposition |
| Core DSA | 13 separate topic rows, no aggregate |
| Independent Transfer | Row exists, unwired |
| Software Building | **Missing** |
| Applied AI/FDE | **Missing** |
| Interview Execution | Row exists, unwired |

- Master §37 inputs that are not used: skill mastery, mock evidence, interview behaviours. Freshness is used only as the unit "maintenance" state. Output is used only as the last finished week's status.

LABS
- 23 labs: 22 required, plus lab-priority-queue (optional).
- aiFde labs: lab-support-router (W12) and lab-fde-workflow (W13).
- 46 lab exercises. None is in any unit path, none has cleanPass, and all have solutions that can be revealed.
- Where labs feed in today: WeekCard builds list (use-course-day.ts:28-32), the weekProgress extras (dead rule), "Weeks so far" completion (readiness-report.tsx:88-90), and the momentum bonus (use-course-day.ts:50).
- Where they do not feed in: readiness(), domains, track, finalDecision.

MASTERY vs FRESHNESS
- lib/mastery.ts statuses never decay; only lastPracticed is stored.
- Skills page shows the mastery status only. Skill detail shows "Last practiced <date>" (skill-detail.tsx:83).
- The readiness report shows "READY · stale" only when every unit in a domain is ready and one is in maintenance (any attempt older than 14 days, routing.ts:160-162).
- ReadinessCard on Today drops the stale tag.
- training-state.ts freshnessOf (productive passes only, 3/6/12/21/30 days) is used only by the planner. It is a different rule from the unit maintenance rule.

HOW TODAY / WEEK / COURSE / READINESS DERIVE
- Today: the calendar daily target plus dailyCredits, which counts any production rep, outside LC entries, and repeats on later days.
- Week: weekProgress, from credits only.
- Course: courseStatus, from gates and paths.
- Readiness: domains come from Course. The track comes from the Course frontier, output-only finished-week statuses, and recentAssistance.
- InterviewCard computes the transfer grade separately.
- Three definitions of "week complete":
  - road-map.tsx:24 — every unit of the week ready;
  - readiness-report.tsx:90 — output + required labs + gates;
  - weekProgress — output only.

WEEK 14 GATING
- mockPolicy maps correctly: green 2/2, yellow 0/1, red 0/0.
- mocksRequired is never used. mocksAllowed only toggles one link (course-cards.tsx:161).
- /interview is a nav item (header.tsx:21) whose cards all have Start buttons (interview-view.tsx:61-62), with no check.
- mocksDone = distinct in-app mocks completed on any date (progress.ts:331-334).
- The final decision is shown only on Today when week ≥ 14, and never in the Progress report.
- Production clamps today to ≤ 2027-01-31, so Feb 1 itself is never "today". The cd.week fallback to Week 1 for course week 0 or 15 (use-course-day.ts:26) is reachable only through the dev ?asOf parameter.

Note: an untracked scripts/_audit_routing_sim2.ts appeared during this run. It is not mine (another auditor's) and I did not touch it.
alreadyCorrect: lib/course/credit.ts:49-60 masteryEvidence classifies one attempt correctly against the time-ordered history (revealed > reconstructed > assisted > retrieval > self-corrected > cold-independent/independent). Reuse it; only the aggregation around it is wrong.
credit.ts:77-80 gateClean rejects hints, a shown solution, reconstructions and more than 2 failed runs. Checkpoint variants are repType 'cold', so they start cold (lib/progress.ts:194).
routing.ts:69-71 passedIds excludes passes made with the solution shown, so a revealed solution never completes a unit path.
Readiness is per domain with a 'why' string, has no single percentage, and is derived from attempts rather than stored (readiness.ts:46-59).
mockPolicy (readiness.ts:120-124) maps green/yellow/red to 2/2, 0/1 and 0/0 as spec §25 asks, and the calendar never makes mocks required. Only enforcement is missing.
transferGrade excludes assisted, reconstructed, revealed and fast-repeat passes from 'independent'. Its thresholds are explicit, and failed abandoned tries count as attempted.

The readiness track implements master spec §38 signals with reasons: behind the calendar via the teaching-order frontier, blocked gates, last week's status, and assistance thresholds (readiness.ts:141-157).
Domain-level staleness exists, and the full report shows 'READY · stale' (readiness.ts:51; readiness-report.tsx:47).

labProgress (labs.ts:23-30) is binary: it needs every design answer, a build pass, a change-request pass, every review check, and an explicit doneAt. All 23 labs are linked to units through labIds, and the aiFde flag exists on 2 labs.
The 'Weeks so far' completion check already combines output, required (non-optional) labs and live gates (readiness-report.tsx:90). It is a good basis for a single week contract.
Every checkpoint pool rep exists (120/120), and no unit or domain shows as ready with zero evidence on day 1.
A per-skill freshness model already exists in training-state.ts freshnessOf (productive passes only, 3/6/12/21/30 days). It can drive MASTERED·FRESH / MASTERED·STALE.
There is one credit source (dailyCredits via useCredits) shared by Today, the Week card, 'Weeks so far' and the road map.

findings.title: Evidence report merges independent + retrieval + cold-independent under 'Cold, independent'
findings.evidence: lib/course/readiness.ts:84 `coldIndependent: counts['cold-independent'] + counts.independent + counts.retrieval,`; readiness.ts:61-68 EvidenceSummary has no independent or retrieval field; components/course/readiness-report.tsx:66 `['Cold, independent', r.evidence.coldIndependent],`; lib/course/credit.ts:59 `return a.retrievalType === 'cold' ? 'cold-independent' : 'independent'`
findings.detail: §11 says exactly this must not happen. Six categories are required, but only four tiles exist, and one of them combines three kinds of evidence. 215 of the 272 'full' reps (capstones, transfer, pattern-stage and interview-stage reps) are 'first-exposure' on the first attempt (lib/progress.ts:194-199). A clean first try on them is 'independent' (credit.ts:59), yet the report calls it cold. Simulation: one clean first-exposure pass on cap-two-sum shows 'Cold, independent: 1'. The report overstates the strongest kind of evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Return six separate counts from evidenceSummary (coldIndependent, independent, selfCorrected, assisted, reconstructed, retrieval) and render six labelled tiles. Update readiness.test.ts `calm` and add a test that a first-exposure pass is never counted as cold.

findings.title: finalDecision declares 'Ready' or 'Ready with targeted gaps' on evidence that does not support it
findings.specSection: §11 'no stronger language than the evidence supports'; §25; master §17 Week 14, §18, §37
findings.evidence: readiness.ts:166-171 `if (grade === 'green' && notReady <= 1 && mocksDone >= 1) return 'ready'` / `if (grade !== 'red' && notReady <= 4) return 'ready-with-gaps'`; course-cards.tsx:141 `const mocksDone = program.mocks.completed`; lib/progress.ts:331-333 mockProgress counts distinct mocks completed on any date; data/course/motivation.ts:151-152 'Ready to start interviewing, with targeted gaps.'
findings.detail:
Simulations:
- Yellow, with foundations + decomposition + graphs + dp not ready and 0 mocks → 'ready-with-gaps' ('Ready to start interviewing'), even though the yellow policy itself says 'More transfer'.
- Green with 1 mock → 'ready', although the green policy requires 2 mocks.
- mocksDone counts any in-app mock ever completed, including one from the pre-course October plan, so READY needs no Week-14 mock.
- Green, all domains stale → 'ready'.
- Green while the track is off-track → 'ready'.
All 15 domains count equally, ignoring the §18 Tier-A list. Labs, assistance dependence and freshness are ignored. The 'not-ready' text says 'the report says exactly why', but no reasons are shown anywhere.
findings.suggestedFix: Base the decision on Tier-A domains being ready and fresh, the transfer grade, Week-14 mocks completed after a green grade (and reviewed), an acceptable track and assistance level, and Software Building. Return the reasons with the decision and render them. Add tests for each of these cases.

findings.title: Evidence anchored to the first passing attempt in unsorted order; later stronger evidence never upgrades it
findings.specSection: §11 'later stronger evidence can upgrade the report'; §29 readiness tests
findings.evidence: readiness.ts:74-79 `const seen = new Set<string>()` ... `if (!a.passed || !a.completedAt || seen.has(a.exerciseId) || ...) continue` `seen.add(a.exerciseId)`; lib/storage/local.ts:26-28 getAll; lib/storage/sync.ts:103 `for (const r of rows) if (!m.has(r.id)) m.set(r.id, r)`; lib/sessions.ts:13-14 crypto.randomUUID(); rep-workspace.tsx:617-623 viewSolution persists `solutionViewed: true`; rep-workspace.tsx:1178-1180 'Solution hidden while you rebuild it from memory.'
findings.detail:
Only one attempt per rep is ever counted. Within a session that is roughly the earliest; after a reload it is effectively random, because the cache loads in IndexedDB key order and the keys are random UUIDs.
- Simulation A: assisted pass, then a cold clean pass. Chronological order gives assisted 1; reversed order gives cold 1.
- Simulation B: a pass after viewing the solution is classified 'revealed' and takes the rep's slot. That category is never displayed, so the later reconstruction and cold re-solve of that rep never count ([revealed, reconstructed, retrieval] → every bucket 0).
The app's built-in flow is to rebuild in the same attempt after viewing a solution, so 'Rebuilt after a solution' is close to always 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Sort attempts by time. For each rep, report the strongest (or latest) evidence, and optionally the first-attempt evidence alongside it. Never let 'revealed' take the slot. Add tests for an upgrade (assisted, then cold) and for revealed → reconstructed → cold.

findings.title: Most checkpoint evidence never reaches the evidence panel (63 of 120 checkpoint variants excluded)
findings.evidence: readiness.ts:72 `const full = (e?: Exercise) => Boolean(e && (e.repType === 'capstone' || e.transfer || e.gate || e.stage === 'pattern' || e.stage === 'interview'))`; readiness-report.tsx:77 'Full problems only: capstones, checkpoints, unlabeled and interview problems.'; data/course/gates.ts pools such as g-hashing `['o2-cold-letter-counts', ...]`

Every variant of g-hashing, g-fixed-window, g-variable-window, g-stack, g-search-invariant, g-safe-rewiring, g-tree-contract, g-grid, g-heap, g-backtracking and g-matrix is excluded, plus some variants of 8 others. Simulation: a clean cold pass on o2-cold-two-sum leaves every bucket at 0. The footnote claims checkpoints are included.
findings.suggestedFix: Count a rep as full when it is in a checkpoint pool: `|| Boolean(GATE_OF_EXERCISE[e.id])`. Alternatively, set `gate: true` on those pool reps. Add a test.

findings.detail: The only signal is a '· stale' tag on fully-ready domains in the Progress report. Today's card drops it, the Skills pages show mastery with no freshness, and skill mastery is never used by readiness. Unit staleness follows a different rule from the skill freshness model: any attempt counts, including a failed one or one that only viewed a solution. Simulation M: a stale hashing domain becomes fresh when the learner merely views a solution on one rep. The stale 'why' text says 'it comes back as retrieval', but routing.ts:224-225 schedules only LeetCode targets for ready or maintenance units.
findings.suggestedFix: Derive freshness from training-state's freshnessOf (productive passes only) for skills and units. Show MASTERED·FRESH / MASTERED·STALE / DEVELOPING in Progress and in the readiness card. Schedule real retrieval for stale mastered units, or drop the claim.

findings.title: Today's readiness card shows only the first five started domains and hides weaker later ones

findings.detail: Domains are listed in teaching order, so from Week 6 onward the card shows the oldest domains, which are the most likely to be ready. Simulation L (Week 8, recursion gate-blocked): the card shows five READY rows (foundations, decomposition, hashing, pointers, windows) and hides 'Recursion: DEVELOPING'. No per-domain reason is shown.
findings.suggestedFix: Show blocked and developing domains first (with their why text), then a count of ready domains. Alternatively, show the aggregate §18 dimensions.

findings.title: Outside LeetCode evidence (unaided, hinted, rebuilt, cold re-solve) never reaches readiness
findings.evidence: use-course-day.ts:39 `const ev = evidenceSummary(attempts, EXERCISE_BY_ID, today)`; readiness.ts:71 signature takes no SolveEntry list; lib/solve-log.ts SolveEntry has `result: 'unaided' | 'hinted' | 'failed'` and `rebuilt?: boolean`
findings.detail: Real LeetCode solves and re-solves logged in the solve log are the most interview-like evidence, but they are not in the evidence panel, the track, the domains or the final decision. A later cold re-solve, the strongest evidence in §10, is invisible to readiness.
findings.suggestedFix: Pass solve entries to evidenceSummary and classify them into the same evidence categories (unaided first solve, hinted, solution viewed, rebuilt, cold re-solve). Map them to domains through the unit targets.

findings.title: transferGrade depends on array order, and memorizedRisk is effectively inert
findings.evidence: readiness.ts:106 `const first = as.find((a) => a.passed && a.completedAt)` (unsorted); :109 `!(first && memorizedRisk(first, attempts))`; :180 `const solvedBefore = attempts.some((b) => b.exerciseId === a.exerciseId && b.passed && b.date < a.date)`
findings.detail: Simulation E: the same two attempts on one transfer rep give independent 0 in chronological order and 1 (freshFull 1) in reversed order. After a reload the order is UUID order, so the grade, and with it mockPolicy and finalDecision, can change. When the attempts are in chronological order, the first passing attempt never has an earlier pass of the same exerciseId, so memorizedRisk(first) is always false. None of the 48 bank reps has a problemId, so recall of a known problem cannot be detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Sort by time and define the transfer attempt as the chronologically first attempt (pass or fail). Detect memorized risk by problem identity (LeetCode number or signature), not only by exerciseId.

findings.title: Domain 'ready' text says 'Every checkpoint cleared, cold.' when some units have no checkpoint and their path may include hinted passes

findings.detail: The units w1-state-while, w1-integration, w2-improve and w7-bst have no gate. They become ready when their path is done, and hinted passes count toward that. The foundations, decomposition and trees domains then claim cold checkpoints for work that was never checkpointed.

findings.suggestedFix: Add unit tests for each of these, plus an e2e test that a red-graded learner cannot open /interview/[mockId].

result.summary: Day and week completion count reps only, and several places decide "complete" in different ways that can disagree. On Today, "Day complete · You did enough" shows exactly when the day is a training day (Mon–Fri, not a holiday) and credits.items[today].length ≥ dailyTarget (10/12/15). Labs, checkpoints, repairs and target problems are never checked. Once the count is met, Today also hides any required checkpoint or repair still queued, or offers it as "Bonus". Nothing assigns a lab, checkpoint or target problem to a day (no per-day schedule). Labs never enter the course queue at all. Gates enter only after a unit's whole path is passed, and only if they fit in the remaining slots. Week 2's target problems cannot be prescribed in Week 2. The week card only ever shows On track / Recoverable / Off track, from counts. The one lab/checkpoint check in weekProgress needs `today > Sunday`, and no screen ever calls it that way. So the card says "On track" on Saturday and Sunday with 0/2 builds, and Saturday says "week N is already covered". "Week N complete" exists only in Progress → Weeks so far, and the Road map uses yet another rule. The streak, the flame (blaze), the celebration and milestones all count reps only, and the Progress page shows a second, V1 streak. I also simulated a learner who does exactly what Today prescribes. That learner cannot complete Week 1: a routing deadlock in lib/course/routing.ts keeps the first unit from ever becoming ready, so no Week-1 checkpoint is ever offered. Today keeps saying "Day complete" and fills the days with Week-2 reps. Rest-day handling and zero debt for planned rest are mostly right.
result.data:
EXACT RULES AS IMPLEMENTED
- "Day complete" (course-today.tsx:68): day.type==='training' && credits.items[today].length >= dailyTarget(week). Never true on Saturday (recovery), Sunday or holidays. The same count drives the copy (motivation.ts:164), the flame blaze (week-status.ts:118), the celebration (course-today.tsx:77-92) and the milestone (course-today.tsx:203).
- Week card status (week-status.ts:60-79): on-track if credits so far >= (training days before today + today only once its target is met) × rate. Recoverable if the shortfall is at most one day's rate, otherwise off-track. Labs and gates count only when today > the week's Sunday, which no screen ever passes. There is no 'complete' value.
- "Week N complete" (readiness-report.tsx:90, Progress page, finished weeks only): done >= target && every non-optional lab done && every live gate cleared. Target problems are ignored.
- Road map 'Complete' (road-map.tsx:24): every unit of the week is ready or maintenance. Counts, labs and targets are ignored.

EVERY PLACE THAT DECIDES "COMPLETE"
Day level:
1. course-today.tsx:68
2. motivation.ts:164 (todayLine)
3. week-status.ts:118 flameFor, used by use-course-day.ts:49 and week-strip.tsx:19/31-32 ("x/y, done")
4. week-status.ts:105 trainingStreak
5. week-status.ts:66 todayDone and :86 daysComplete (shown at readiness-report.tsx:100)
6. week-status.ts:132-134 momentum (computed but never rendered)
7. today-plan.ts:164 prescribe complete = repsDone >= N, which is true on rest days and covered Saturdays (N = 0)
8. progress-90.ts:38-47 via progress-view.tsx:70: the V1 "working days in a row" streak (any activity, 90-day calendar that ends 2027-01-09)
Pre-course only: today-training.tsx:132 "Training complete" and dashboard.tsx:189.
Week level:
1. week-status.ts:71-78 weekProgress.status
2. readiness-report.tsx:90 local `complete`
3. road-map.tsx:23-24 weekState
4. use-course-day.ts:34 finished-week statuses (counts only), which feed readiness.ts:148-152
5. motivation.ts:114-116 Saturday "already covered" (from week-status.ts:27)
6. course-cards.tsx:27-35 WeekCard pill and copy

- Lab parts in any unit path: 0, so labs never enter the course queue.
- Multiple-choice (non-crediting) reps in required paths: W2 5, W8 1, W14 7.

SCENARIO A: Week 3, exactly 15 credits Mon–Fri, labs 0/2, checkpoints 0/3
- Mon–Fri: "Day complete 15/15" with celebrate tone, flame blaze, streak 11→15, week card "on-track".
- Sat 11-14: optionalTarget 0, header "Nothing owed", 0 items, no CTA. Line: "Saturday is optional, and week 3 is already covered. Rest is part of the plan." Week card still on-track.
- Sun: on-track.
- Monday after: weekProgress with the lab/gate extras gives 'recoverable', but no screen calls it that way.
- The finished-week status fed to readiness is 'on-track'.
- 74/75 with every lab and gate done gives 'recoverable'.

SCENARIO B: prescribe() directly
- Capacity 10, 10 credited reps done, plan = [repair (required), gate (required)] → complete=true, undone items=[], optional=[repair, gate]. Today then shows "Day complete", "Tomorrow: <repair>" and "Bonus: <repair>".
- Capacity 0 (covered Saturday) → complete=true, 0 items.
- Gate at queue position 11 of a 10-rep day → not prescribed.

SCENARIO C: learner who does every prescribed item cleanly each training day (skips Saturdays, empty mastery)
| Day | Credits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Oct 26 | 10/10 complete | |
| Oct 27 | 9/10 | o2-list-literal is multiple choice |
| Oct 28 | 10/10 | |
| Oct 29 | 9/10 | o2-set-empty is multiple choice |
| Oct 30 | 10/10 | |
- Once 40% of w1-state-while is passed, its route becomes 'focused'. d05-while-halve [trace] leaves the path but pathDone still requires it, so the unit never becomes ready.
- w1-loop-control, w1-running-state, w1-mutation-references and w1-integration stay locked. No Week-1 gate is ever queued. From Oct 27 the plan fills with Week-2 w2-hashing reps.
- Week 1 ends 48/50 'recoverable', gates 0/4, labs 0/2, 47 Week-1 path reps never offered.
- Week 2: placement on Nov 4. On Nov 5–6 Today prescribes 0 items on training days. Week 2 ends 26/60 off-track, gates 1/5.
- Week 3: only Week-2 target problems (2, 2, 1 per day), then nothing.
- Other gate-less units with lesson-level reps after the 40% mark: w2-improve (o2-comp-set-trace) and w7-bst (b230-trace-inorder).

Milestones: crossing 50 on a Saturday (for example 45 by Friday, then 5 on Saturday) is never shown. MILESTONES = [50, 250, 500, 750, 950], with no "first training day".
alreadyCorrect: Planned rest creates zero debt in the targets: weekTarget = training days × daily rate, with holidays and Sundays excluded (data/course/calendar.ts:69-83). Week targets match the V2 table (50, 60, 75×6, 60, 45, 75, 75, 60, 75), and lib/course/course.test.ts:11 tests this.

courseDay gives rest days and holidays target 0 and Saturday target 0, with only an optional shortfall (lib/course/week-status.ts:21-31). Missed days never raise the next day's target (lib/course/capacity.ts:37 uses the constant rate).

trainingStreak skips rest and recovery days, and an unfinished today does not break it (week-status.ts:101-110), so planned rest protects the streak. Tests cover Christmas and New Year (week-status.test.ts:46-56). Saturday work counts toward the week's output but not the streak, which matches 'required training days'.

The rest-day Today view is guilt-free: 'Rest day', 'Nothing is due. Your plan is intact.', 'rest day, streak protected', and no plan or CTA (course-today.tsx:130-145, motivation.ts:111-112). The week strip shows rest as ☾, not an empty failure circle (week-strip.tsx:38-39).

One source of qualifying credits: lib/course/credit.ts dailyCredits, used through components/use-credits.ts by Today, the streak, week totals and the road map. A rep counts once per day. Revealed solutions, failures, multiple choice and lab parts do not count (credit.ts:62-67, 95-110).
Today's count and the plan's done list agree: use-today-plan.ts:94-95 filters done items to credited keys, and CourseToday reads credits.items[today].

The code already knows which queue items are required: gate and repair items carry required:true (use-today-plan.ts:65) and bypass the 30% checks cap in foundation weeks (today-plan.ts:120,125). Repairs come before the next gate variant (routing.ts:217-221). A contract can reuse this flag.

weekProgress already accepts labsDone/labsRequired/gatesCleared/gatesRequired (week-status.ts:60,75-78), and use-course-day.ts:28-32 already computes the required (non-optional) labs and the live gates for the current week. The plumbing for a week contract exists.

readiness-report.tsx:90 already combines count, required labs and cleared gates for finished weeks. It is the closest thing to the section 7 week contract and could be lifted into lib/course as the single function (adding target problems).

Labs are binary through labProgress (lib/course/labs.ts:22-29), and lab parts never count as reps (credit.ts:64). The week's labs and checkpoints are at least visible on the Today dashboard in WeekCard (course-cards.tsx:53-86), not only behind Plan.
'Stop for today' is a real, visible choice once the count is met (course-today.tsx:318-327). The celebration fires once per day (course-today.tsx:76-92).
Momentum counts met days rather than reps, so repeating trivial reps cannot farm it (week-status.ts:130-142).

findings.title: "Day complete" counts reps only; required checkpoints, repairs, labs and targets are ignored, then hidden or offered as "Bonus"
findings.specSection: §7 one authoritative daily completion contract; §29 Daily completion; principle 12
findings.evidence: components/course/course-today.tsx:67-68 `const done = cd.doneToday` / `const complete = day.type === 'training' && done >= target`; :166-170 "Day complete" … `{done} / {target} · You did enough.`; :209 `{!complete && next && (` (CTA hidden); :252 `{!complete && plan.items.length > 0 && (` (stack hidden); :311 `plan.optional.find((o) => o.exerciseId)?.title` (Tomorrow); :332-334 `Bonus: {plan.optional.find((o) => o.exerciseId)!.title}`; lib/today-plan.ts:161-164 `const nextPlan = left(input.plan)` … `complete: repsDone >= N`; data/course/motivation.ts:164 `if (target && done >= target) return motivate('day-complete', c)`; components/use-course-day.ts:35 `const done = credits.items[today] ?? []`
findings.detail: `done` is any qualifying credit earned today, not the prescribed items, and nothing in the rule mentions labs, gates, targets or repairs. Checked with prescribe(): capacity 10, 10 credited reps done, plan = [repair (required), gate (required)] gives complete=true, no undone items, optional=[repair, gate]. Today then shows "Day complete 10 / 10 · You did enough.", hides the list and the CTA, and shows the required repair as both "Tomorrow: X" and "Bonus: X". In the Week-3 scenario (15/day, labs 0/2, checkpoints 0/3), every day Mon–Fri shows "Day complete" in celebrate tone. This is exactly what §7 forbids ("Do not show DAY COMPLETE 15 / 15 if a required lab or checkpoint is still unfinished").
findings.suggestedFix: Add one pure function, for example lib/course/contract.ts `dayContract(date, {credits, queue, labs, gates, targets})`. It returns {repsDone, repsTarget, required: [{kind: 'lab'|'gate'|'repair'|'target', id, done}], complete, remaining}, with complete = reps met && every item required today done. Drive CourseToday's `complete`, todayLine, the flame blaze, the celebration, the milestone and the complete panel from it. Never move `required` items into `optional`/Bonus; keep them in the stack with their lock state.

findings.title: Labs, checkpoints and target problems are never assigned to a day; there is no per-day schedule
findings.specSection: §3 Today is the command center; §5 execution stack; §7; §29 Today (every required daily item visible)
findings.evidence: lib/course/week-status.ts:10-19 CourseDay holds only {date, week, type, target, optionalTarget, holiday}; lib/course/routing.ts:178 `QueuePurpose = 'learn' | 'guided' | 'drill' | 'combine' | 'transfer' | 'gate' | 'repair' | 'capstone' | 'problem'` (no lab); routing.ts:220-221 gates only `if (s.path.every((e) => passed.has(e.id)))`; lib/today-plan.ts:120 `count < N`, :130 `!(c.kind === 'problem' && (foundation || !c.ready))`; components/use-course-day.ts:28 `LABS.filter((l) => l.week === week.number)` (used only by WeekCard); components/course/course-cards.tsx:80 gate rows are plain `{g.gate.title}`, not links
findings.detail: Labs never enter the course queue: no unit section contains a lab part (computed: lab parts in unit paths = 0 for all 14 weeks), although weeks 1–13 each have 1–2 required labs. They appear only as links in the separate WeekCard, never in the Today stack and never in any completion rule. Gates reach the day only after the unit's entire path is passed, and only if they fit in the remaining N − done slots. Nothing ever says "checkpoint today". Target problems are filtered out of every foundation-week day. Week 2's five targets [217,242,1,49,128] cannot be prescribed during Week 2; in the simulation they first appear on Nov 9–11.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a per-day schedule derived from the week, for example `dayPlan(week, date, state)`. It assigns each required lab to a training day, places checkpoints when their unit path is due (or on a fixed day), places explicitly required targets, and marks each as required for that day. Render LAB / CHECKPOINT / TARGET rows in the Today stack with lock or unlock state, and make WeekCard rows actionable.

''} is already covered. Rest is part of the plan.` ``; components/course/course-today.tsx:177 `(target ? `${target} reps would close the week` : 'Nothing owed')`; lib/course/capacity.ts:37 `requiredReps: day.type === 'training' ? rate : day.optionalTarget` (prescribe gets N = 0, so no items and no CTA)
